The '''Bitthævrian War''' was a conflict between the [[Bitthævrian/Legends|Bitthævrians]] in the [[Kadok Regions/Legends|Kadok Regions]] against the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], and the [[Kaleesh/Legends|Kaleesh]].

==Prelude==
The [[Bitthævrian/Legends|Bitthævrian]] [[Species/Legends|species]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Guiteica/Legends|Guiteica]],<ref name="Lord of War" /> who also controlled the wider [[Kadok Regions/Legends|Kadok Regions]],<ref name="Galaxy at War" /> had a strained relationship with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] over many [[Standard year/Legends|years]].<ref name="Lord of War" /> Around [[65 BBY/Legends|65 BBY]],<ref name="Galaxy at War" /> a Republic-backed [[Unidentified Republic-backed soldier|soldier]] attempted to depose [[Guiteica's leader]] in a coup and failed, leading the Bitthævrians to rebel against all Republic representation in the Kadok Regions. Corrupt Republic officials hoped to hide their culpability in the incident, and so they manipulated the [[Kaleesh/Legends|Kaleesh]] of the planet [[Kalee/Legends|Kalee]], which bordered the Kadok Regions, into believing falsely that their territory was threatened by the Bitthævrians. Republic agents armed several Kaleesh tribes<ref name="Lord of War" /> and the [[kolkpravis]], the Kaleesh united [[Army/Legends|army]],<ref name="Galaxy at War" /> with [[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka]] [[Outland rifle/Legends|Outland rifles]] so that they could fight against the Bitthævrian [[Militia/Legends|militia]], the [[m'Yalfor'ac Order]].<ref name="Lord of War" />

==The war==
The [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]] sent a group of [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]]<ref name="Lord of War" /> to aid the kolkpravis, including [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] and [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]]. Together, they fought the m'Yalfor'ac Order.<ref name="Galaxy at War" /> One participant in the conflict was the [[Grievous's great-grandmother|great-grandmother]] of the Kaleesh [[Grievous/Legends|Qymaen jai Sheelal]].<ref name="Lord of War" /> The kolkpravis used hopscotch tactics during the war, where, after landing on Bitthævrian worlds, half of their warriors would maintain a front line while those behind them pushed forward. If they lost a battle, the Kaleesh warriors would scatter and take deep cover to wage a guerilla warfare campaign, inflicting demoralizing losses.<ref name="Galaxy at War" /> By approximately [[60 BBY/Legends|60 BBY]], the Kaleesh, including Sheelal, launched an [[invasion of Guiteica]],<ref name="Clone Wars Ep Guide 1 & 2" /> and the Bitthævrians were defeated.<ref name="Galaxy at War" />

==Aftermath==
{{Quote|Gor? ''[roars]''|Grievous mourns the death of Gor, his roggwart taken from Guiteica|<ref name="Lair of Grievous">{{TCW|Lair of Grievous}}</ref> }}
After the invasion of Guiteica, many Kaleesh took home baby [[Roggwart/Legends|roggwarts]], a creature native to the planet, as trophies,<ref name="Clone Wars Ep Guide" /> including Sheelal, who's roggwart was named [[Gor/Legends|Gor]]. They raised the creatures to be devoted pets and watch-beasts.<ref name="Clone Wars Ep Guide 1 & 2" /> Sheelal eventually inherited the Outland rifle his great-grandmother had used in the war.<ref name="Lord of War" /> Shortly after the Bitthævrian War, the Kaleesh were attacked by the [[Yam'rii/Legends|Yam'rii]], causing the [[Huk War]] between the two species.<ref name="Galaxy at War" /> Sheelal rose to prominence as a [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]] in that conflict and changed his name to Grievous.<ref name="Lord of War" /> 

Grievous's great-grandmother's rifle was either lost or destroyed in the [[Martyr|shuttle]] crash on Kalee that resulted in Grievous becoming a [[Cyborg/Legends|cyborg]]<ref name="Lord of War" /> by [[29 BBY/Legends|29 BBY]].<ref name="Crash Date">''[[Dark Lord: The Rise of Darth Vader]]'' states that [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous's]] [[Cyborg/Legends|cyborg]] reconstruction, as portrayed following the crash of the ''[[Martyr]]'' in "[[The Eyes of Revolution]]," had taken place a [[Standard decade/Legends|decade]] earlier, and ''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' places the novel in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]]. Therefore, the ''Martyr'' must have crashed by [[29 BBY/Legends|29 BBY]].</ref> The kolkpravis never learned that they had been the Republic's pawns.<ref name="Galaxy at War" /> Grievous kept Gor until the creature was [[Mission to Grievous's castle/Legends|killed]] in his [[Grievous's castle/Legends|castle]] on the [[Third moon of Vassek/Legends|third moon of Vassek]] by the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Kit Fisto/Legends|Kit Fisto]]<ref name="Lair of Grievous" /> in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].<ref name="TCW Date">{{TCWdates|110}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|The Bitthævrians are an obscure species introduced in the excellent book ''Alliance Intelligence Reports'' (1995, West End Games). Though the story of their conflict with the Galactic Republic was told in that source, Kaleesh involvement in the cultural clash is new.|[[Abel G. Peña]] in the endnotes for "The Story of General Grievous: Lord of War" in 2006|<ref name="Endnotes">{{Blog|abelgpena|67|Endnotes for The Story of General Grievous, Part 4: Lord of Worlds and War}}</ref>}}
The war between the Bitthævrians and the Republic was first mentioned in the [[1995]] [[West End Games]] sourcebook ''[[Alliance Intelligence Reports]]'' by [[Bill Smith]].<ref name="Alliance Intelligence Reports">''[[Alliance Intelligence Reports]]''</ref> It was first identified as the Bitthævrian War in the [[2009]] sourcebook ''[[Galaxy at War]]''.<ref name="Galaxy at War" />
